up: Retrieve approved drugs from ChEMBL that have a clinical phase of 4 (i.e., are approved) and include the following data: preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), max clinical phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), indication heading (drug_indication.mesh_heading), and first approval year (molecule_dictionary.first_approval). Ensure results are distinct, i.e., no duplicate rows for the same molecule, and order the results by the first approval year in descending order (most recent first). Do not include any additional columns or filters beyond those explicitly mentioned.
sql: WITH approved AS ( SELECT d.molregno, d.pref_name, d.max_phase, d.first_approval, d.chembl_id, d.prefered_name, d.first_approval, d.max_phase, di.mesh_heading FROM molecule_dictionary d JOIN drug_indication di ON d.molregno = di.molregno WHERE d.max_phase = 4 ) SELECT DISTINCT d.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, d.max_phase, di.mesh_heading, d.first_approval FROM approved d JOIN compound_structures cs ON d.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON d.molregno = di.molregno WHERE d.max_phase = 4 ORDER BY d.first_approval DESC ;
